description: A byte array and the time stamps of four 200 ms steps.
basis: Recorded once on Arduino Uno R3 (genuine, USB 2341:0043) (serial output, arduino-cli 1.5.1, arduino:avr@1.8.8). Previous basis: derived by hand from the sketch source (C++ semantics, avr-gcc: int is 16 bit) and the 'Beobachtung' comment of the example; time stamps at 0, 200, 400, 600 ms

tolerances.reason: millis() granularity of 1 ms per delay(200) and the few microseconds of the loop body, summed over up to three steps
